Name: OriginalThreePaymentSample
Asserts: 201 with empty body; original three rows, amounts, recipients and descriptions; balances 3674875 / 170075 / 1405050 cents.

Name: OriginalTwoPaymentExample
Asserts: 201; separate two-payment example; exact rows and derived balances 4849925 / 170075 / 230000 cents.

Name: ExactBalance
Asserts: Spending the entire payer balance succeeds, leaves zero and creates the exact payment row.

Name: OneCentLeadingZerosAndUppercaseUUID
Asserts: Leading-zero one-cent amount and uppercase UUIDs succeed; exactly one cent moves.

Name: LiteralDescription
Asserts: Unicode and SQL-looking description text is stored unchanged; tables remain intact.

Name: EmptyDescription
Asserts: An explicitly present empty description succeeds and is stored as an empty string.

Name: MaximumBatchAccepted
Asserts: 1000 one-cent entries succeed as 1000 separate rows with exact aggregate balances.

Name: MaximumIntegerCentsAccepted
Asserts: 21474836.47 dollars succeeds when funded and recipient capacity permits; exact INTEGER balances and row.

Name: InsufficientFundsWholeBatch
Asserts: An unaffordable multi-payment batch returns 422/insufficient_funds and leaves all balances and rows unchanged.

Name: UnknownPayer
Asserts: Unknown payer returns 422/unknown_firm; no writes.

Name: UnknownRecipientWholeBatch
Asserts: A valid plus unknown recipient returns 422/unknown_firm; neither payment commits.

Name: RecipientOverflowWholeBatch
Asserts: A recipient overflow returns 422/balance_overflow and rolls back every batch write.

Name: RollbackAfterFirstInsert
Asserts: Injected second-insert failure returns generic 500; balances and first insert roll back; SQL details stay private.

Name: RejectMalformedJSON
Asserts: Malformed JSON returns 400/invalid_json; no writes.

Name: RejectUnknownFields
Asserts: Unknown root or payment fields return 400/invalid_json; no writes.

Name: RejectExtraJSONDocument
Asserts: Two JSON documents return 400/invalid_json; no writes.

Name: RejectNumericAmount
Asserts: Numeric amount returns 400/invalid_json; no writes.

Name: RejectMissingAndNullFields
Asserts: Each required root/payment field omitted or null, null root and null payment entry return 422/invalid_request; no writes.

Name: RejectEmptyBatch
Asserts: Empty array returns 422/invalid_request; no writes.

Name: RejectSelfPayment
Asserts: Self-payment returns 422/invalid_request; no writes.

Name: RejectInvalidUUID
Asserts: Malformed and surrounding-whitespace payer or payee UUIDs return 422/invalid_request; no writes.

Name: RejectInvalidAmounts
Asserts: 0, 0.00, -0.00, -1, +1, .01, 1., 0.001, 1e2, surrounding whitespace, 21474836.48 and 21474837 return 422/invalid_request; no writes.

Name: RejectBatchTotalOverflow
Asserts: Valid entries totalling INTEGER maximum plus one cent return 422/invalid_request; no writes.

Name: RejectTooManyPayments
Asserts: 1001 entries return 422/invalid_request; no writes.

Name: RejectOversizedBody
Asserts: A body exactly one byte above 1 MiB returns 413/request_too_large; no writes.

Name: RejectUnsupportedMediaType
Asserts: Non-JSON supplied Content-Type returns 415/unsupported_media_type; no writes.

Name: AcceptedMediaTypes
Asserts: JSON with charset and omitted Content-Type both accept valid requests with exact rows and balances.

Name: HealthAndReadiness
Asserts: Both API and both ledger processes return 200 for liveness and readiness.

Name: MethodAndRouteBoundary
Asserts: GET payment route returns 405; unknown route returns 404; no writes.

Name: DirectPrivateRoute
Asserts: Private route independently enforces 201 commit and 422 insufficient-funds rejection with exact persistent state.

Name: ConcurrentOverspend
Asserts: 12 requests across two API/two ledger processes yield exactly one success and eleven insufficient-funds denials; exact state and conserved total.

Name: ConcurrentOpposingTransfers
Asserts: 40 opposing requests all commit without deadlock; 40 reconciled rows, original balances and conserved total.

Name: ConcurrentSharedRecipient
Asserts: 40 requests from two payers credit one recipient without lost updates; exact balances, 40 reconciled rows and conserved total.

Name: LockDeadlineRollback
Asserts: Held PostgreSQL lock produces bounded 504 without writes; valid processing resumes after release.

Name: LedgerUnavailable
Asserts: Stopped ledger produces API 503 and readiness 503 while liveness stays 200; no writes; readiness recovers on restart.

Name: LedgerRedirectNotFollowed
Asserts: Real Nginx canonical redirect produces 503; exactly one proxy request, no follow or retry, and no writes.

Name: LedgerMalformedResponse
Asserts: Real Nginx rate-limit HTML 503 is rejected as an invalid ledger error body; one attempted call after setup, no retry, and no writes.

Name: LedgerTimeoutNoRetry
Asserts: A real PostgreSQL row lock blocks the ledger until its deadline; 504/timeout within nine seconds and no writes.

Name: ReplayIsNewPayment
Asserts: Two identical successful requests create two payment rows and execute two transfers.

Name: ZeroBalancePayer
Asserts: A zero-cent payer cannot send one cent; 422; no writes.

Name: ZeroBalanceRecipient
Asserts: A zero-cent recipient receives one cent with exact debit and credit.

Name: PayerOneCentBelowTotal
Asserts: Payer balance one cent below batch total rejects the entire batch.

Name: PayerOneCentAboveTotal
Asserts: Payer balance one cent above batch total accepts it and leaves one cent.

Name: DuplicateEntriesRemainSeparate
Asserts: Identical entries create separate rows and two credits; no deduplication.

Name: GrossTotalIncludesEveryDuplicate
Asserts: Individually affordable duplicate entries that are jointly unaffordable reject the complete batch.

Name: RepeatedRecipientExactCapacity
Asserts: Combined repeated-recipient credits reach exactly 2147483647 cents with separate rows.

Name: RepeatedRecipientOneCentOverflow
Asserts: Individually safe repeated-recipient credits whose aggregate exceeds capacity by one cent reject the complete batch.

Name: FullRecipientRejectsOneCent
Asserts: A recipient already at INTEGER maximum cannot receive one cent; no writes.

Name: MaximumBalancePayerDebitsOneCent
Asserts: Payer at INTEGER maximum sends one cent without overflow.

Name: LargestWholeDollarAmount
Asserts: 21474836 dollars transfers 2147483600 cents and leaves 47 cents from a maximum-funded payer.

Name: BatchTotalExactlyIntegerMaximum
Asserts: Multiple entries summing to INTEGER maximum succeed with exact rows and balances.

Name: TenthsAndHundredthsAreExact
Asserts: 0.1 plus 0.2 plus 0.30 transfers exactly 60 cents without rounding loss.

Name: CentCarryIsExact
Asserts: 0.99 plus 0.01 transfers exactly 100 cents.

Name: LongLeadingZeroAmount
Asserts: 256 leading zeroes before 1.25 preserve the exact 125-cent amount.

Name: InvalidEntryAtEveryPosition
Asserts: Invalid first, middle or final entry rejects the whole batch without writes.

Name: SelfPaymentAlongsideValidPayment
Asserts: A valid entry plus self-payment rejects both.

Name: UppercaseSelfPayment
Asserts: Case differences cannot bypass self-payment rejection.

Name: PaymentOrderPreservesTotals
Asserts: Reordering entries preserves balances while stored rows follow submitted order.

Name: RejectionPreservesEarlierCommittedPayment
Asserts: A rejected later batch leaves the earlier committed payment and balances intact.

Name: SQLFailureThenValidPayment
Asserts: Service successfully handles a valid payment after an injected SQL failure rolls back.

Name: ConcurrentExactlyFundedRequests
Asserts: 20 concurrent one-cent requests against 20 cents all succeed and leave zero; rows reconcile and total is conserved.

Name: ConcurrentOneBeyondFunding
Asserts: 21 competing one-cent requests against 20 cents yield 20 successes and one denial; exact balances and rows.

Name: ConcurrentRepeatedRecipientBatches
Asserts: Competing two-entry batches commit only whole affordable batches with separate rows, exact aggregate credits and conserved total.

Name: ConcurrentRecipientCapacity
Asserts: Competing credits stop exactly at recipient capacity; rejected batches debit neither payer; rows reconcile.

Name: ConcurrentDisjointTransfers
Asserts: Concurrent disjoint firm sets all commit with exact balances, reconciled rows and conserved total.

Name: ReciprocalOneCentBalances
Asserts: Two firms starting with one cent exchange concurrent one-cent transfers without deadlock or creating money.

Name: BodyExactlyAtLimit
Asserts: A valid body padded to exactly 1 MiB succeeds with exact persistent state.
